about.hero.title: About Iris Polymere
about.body: Iris Polymere develops compound and masterbatch solutions for cable, plastics, extrusion, and industrial manufacturing applications. With a production-focused approach, the company supports customers seeking consistent quality, efficient processing, and application-specific material solutions across Algeria, North Africa, the Middle East, and export markets.
about.focus.title: Where We Focus
about.focus.p1: Iris Polymere is a chemical compound and masterbatch manufacturer or supplier, formulating materials that support cable manufacturers, PVC profile and pipe producers, plastics processors and industrial production teams.
about.focus.p2: The company does not manufacture finished cables — Iris Polymere develops compound solutions for cable production and other manufacturing applications, supporting the extrusion and processing operations of its customers.
vision.hero.title: Vision and Mission
vision.vision.title: Vision
vision.vision.text: To become a trusted regional and international compound partner by combining technical expertise, consistent quality, responsive service, and application-focused innovation.
vision.mission.title: Mission
vision.mission.text: To provide reliable compound solutions that help manufacturers improve processing efficiency, product consistency, cost control, and material performance.
quality.hero.title: Quality Policy
quality.intro: Our quality approach is built around consistency, traceability and continuous improvement across every stage of compound development.
quality.point6: Compliance with applicable standards and requirements
sustain.hero.title: Sustainability
sustain.intro: Iris Polymere approaches sustainability through practical, production-level measures rather than broad claims. Our focus areas include:
sustain.note: These are ongoing focus areas rather than certified outcomes. Iris Polymere does not claim carbon neutrality or specific environmental certification unless formally verified and communicated separately.
production.hero.title: Production and Technology
production.intro: Our production approach centres on formulation discipline and process consistency, from raw material control through to final quality checks.
production.point1.title: Compound Development
production.point1.text: Formulations are developed to match customer application requirements and processing conditions.
production.point2.title: Production Consistency
production.point2.text: Process controls are applied to support batch-to-batch consistency in compound output.
production.point3.title: Raw Material Control
production.point3.text: Incoming raw materials are managed to support stable, predictable compound performance.
production.point4.title: Application-Specific Formulation
production.point4.text: Compounds are tailored to the specific processing method and end-use application of each customer.
production.point5.title: Quality Control
production.point5.text: Quality checkpoints are applied through the production process to support consistent output.
production.point6.title: Customer-Oriented Technical Solutions
production.point6.text: Our technical team works with customers to align compound properties with their production goals.
pvc.hero.title: PVC Compounds
pvc.hero.lead: Rigid, flexible and cable-grade PVC compound formulations developed for profiles, pipes, technical extrusion and cable production.
pvc.intro: Iris Polymere formulates PVC compounds to support manufacturers seeking dimensional stability, consistent processing and application-specific performance. Our PVC range is organised into three groups, each developed around the practical requirements of its target production process.
pvc.rigid.title: Rigid PVC Compound
pvc.rigid.desc: Formulated for PVC profiles, pipes and fittings, technical extrusion products and construction applications.
pvc.flexible.title: Soft PVC Compound
pvc.flexible.subtitle: Flexible PVC Compound
pvc.flexible.desc: Developed for flexible profiles, hoses, seals, gaskets and other flexible plastic components.
pvc.cable.title: Cable Industry
pvc.cable.desc: PVC compounds developed for cable insulation, sheathing and general-purpose cable production.
pvc.benefits.title: Key Benefits
hffr.hero.title: HFFR Compounds
hffr.hero.lead: Halogen-free flame-retardant compound solutions developed for cable applications requiring balanced processability, mechanical properties and fire performance.
hffr.intro: Iris Polymere's HFFR range supports cable manufacturers seeking reliable extrusion behaviour, consistent production and application-focused compound performance. Final cable compliance always depends on formulation, cable design, processing conditions and testing.
hffr.hm2.title: HM-2
hffr.hm2.desc: A halogen-free flame-retardant compound solution developed for cable applications requiring balanced processability, mechanical properties, and fire performance.
hffr.hm4.title: HM-4
hffr.hm4.desc: An application-focused HFFR compound designed for reliable extrusion, consistent production, and cable manufacturing requirements.
hffr.hm5.title: HM-5
hffr.hm5.desc: A performance-oriented HFFR compound suitable for demanding cable production processes and specialized application needs.
hffr.bedding.title: Bedding
hffr.bedding.desc: A cable bedding compound designed to support cable structure, process stability, and production consistency.
hffr.filler.title: Filler
hffr.filler.desc: A cost-efficient filler compound solution designed to support production optimization while maintaining consistent processing performance.
hffr.cpr.title: CPR Application
hffr.cpr.desc: HFFR compound solutions developed for cable applications subject to CPR-related performance requirements.
hffr.cpr.caution: Designed for CPR-related cable applications. Suitable for formulations developed around relevant cable performance requirements. Final cable compliance depends on formulation, cable design, processing conditions, and testing.
mb.hero.title: Masterbatch Solutions
mb.hero.lead: Colour, white, black and filler masterbatch ranges developed for consistent coloration, dispersion and cost-efficient plastic production.
mb.intro: Iris Polymere's masterbatch range covers colour, white, black and filler solutions, each formulated to support stable processing and application-specific results across plastic manufacturing processes.
mb.color.title: Color Masterbatch
mb.color.desc: Colour masterbatch solutions designed to provide consistent coloration, reliable dispersion, and stable processing across plastic production applications.
mb.white.title: White Masterbatch
mb.white.desc: High-opacity white masterbatch available in two TiO₂ concentrations to match dosing and cost requirements.
mb.white.50.title: White Masterbatch — 50% TiO₂
mb.white.50.desc: A white masterbatch solution developed for balanced opacity, dispersion, processability, and cost efficiency.
mb.white.70.title: White Masterbatch — 70% TiO₂
mb.white.70.desc: A high-concentration white masterbatch solution developed for applications requiring stronger opacity and efficient dosing.
mb.black.title: Black Masterbatch
mb.black.desc: Black masterbatch solutions available in UV-resistant and high-gloss variants.
mb.black.uv.title: Black Masterbatch — High UV Resistance
mb.black.uv.desc: A black masterbatch solution developed for outdoor and UV-sensitive plastic applications.
mb.black.gloss.title: Black Masterbatch — High Gloss
mb.black.gloss.desc: A black masterbatch solution developed for applications requiring strong surface appearance and consistent coloration.
mb.filler.title: Filler Masterbatch
mb.filler.subtitle: CaCO₃ + PE/PP Compound
mb.filler.desc: An economical and high-performance solution developed to support cost optimization, process consistency, and efficient resource use in plastic production.
mb.filler.note: Performance may vary depending on polymer type, formulation, machinery, dosage, and end-product requirements.
footer.desc: Iris Polymere develops PVC, HFFR, masterbatch and filler compound solutions for cable, plastics and industrial manufacturing, serving Algeria, North Africa, the Middle East and export markets.
